datasets.title: Landsat 4–9 Collection 2 Level-2 surface reflectance (SR)
datasets.description: Surface reflectance and available surface temperature. Covers TM, ETM+, OLI/TIRS; QA, scaling and sensor harmonization matter. Some USGS asset links require USGS EROS authentication.

datasets.title: Sentinel-2 Level-2A surface reflectance (SR)
datasets.access: Public metadata; many public COG assets
datasets.description: Multispectral surface reflectance. 2015 is the mission era, not guaranteed L2A catalog coverage at every location. Band resolutions and processing baselines differ.

datasets.title: Sentinel-1 ground range detected
datasets.access: Public metadata; inspect asset access and format
datasets.description: C-band SAR acquisitions. Pixel spacing is not effective spatial resolution. GRD is not interchangeable with calibrated, terrain-corrected backscatter.

datasets.title: Sentinel-1 radiometrically terrain-corrected
datasets.access: Public metadata; Azure assets commonly need temporary SAS signing
datasets.description: Terrain-corrected SAR for backscatter analysis. Actual archive start, polarization and regional coverage depend on the provider.

datasets.title: Copernicus DEM GLO-30
datasets.access: Public metadata and COGs; provider terms apply
datasets.description: Static digital surface model based mainly on TanDEM-X acquisitions from 2011–2015. Not a continuously updated terrain time series.

datasets.title: NASADEM (reprocessed SRTM)
datasets.access: Public metadata; Azure assets commonly need temporary SAS signing
datasets.description: Static elevation from the February 2000 SRTM mission, reprocessed later. Not global polar coverage and not a current elevation observation.

datasets.title: ESA WorldCover
datasets.access: Public metadata; Azure assets commonly need temporary SAS signing
datasets.description: 2020 and 2021 global land-cover maps; not an annual current feed. Algorithm/version changes complicate direct change detection.

datasets.title: JRC Global Surface Water
datasets.provider: Microsoft Planetary Computer / European Commission JRC
datasets.access: Public metadata; Azure assets commonly need temporary SAS signing
datasets.description: Landsat-derived surface-water statistics. The provider's release determines covered years; aggregate products are not individual dated scenes.

datasets.title: MODIS Terra MOD09A1 Version 6.1
datasets.access: Public metadata; Azure assets commonly need temporary SAS signing
datasets.description: Moderate-resolution surface reflectance composites. QA and composite intervals differ from Landsat/Sentinel scenes; check current ingestion lag.

datasets.title: MODIS Terra MOD13A1 Version 6.1
datasets.access: Public metadata; Azure assets commonly need temporary SAS signing
datasets.description: Precomputed NDVI/EVI composite products. Apply product scale factors and QA before comparing values; current ingestion is provider-dependent.

datasets.title: Sentinel-2 Level-1C TOA reflectance
datasets.access: Public metadata; JP2 imagery on requester-pays S3 may require AWS/provider retrieval
datasets.description: Top-of-atmosphere reflectance product, not surface reflectance. Bands use encoded integers; read per-asset scale/offset and processing baseline. Current S3 band links are not supported by the HTTP-only downloader.

datasets.title: Landsat Collection 2 Level-1 DN (TOA calibration required)
datasets.access: Public metadata; USGS EROS login or requester-pays AWS access may be required for bands and MTL
datasets.description: Global Level-1 archive delivered as digital numbers, not calibrated TOA reflectance. Use the matching MTL coefficients and solar elevation for supported reflective bands. MSS/thermal require other calibration workflows.

datasets.title: Landsat Collection 2 US ARD TOA reflectance
datasets.resolution: 30 m reflective bands; regional ARD grid
datasets.access: Public metadata; USGS EROS login or requester-pays AWS access may be required
datasets.description: TOA reflectance ARD product with regional U.S. coverage (CONUS, Alaska, Hawaii), not a global archive. Read product scale/offset and QA; the ARD grid differs from ordinary scenes. Do not treat it as SR or apply Level-1 DN calibration again.
